<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 700 480" width="100%" height="100%">
  <!-- White background rect -->
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#ffffff" />

  <!-- Title / Figure label -->
  <text x="350" y="445" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Fig. 8.1</text>

  <!-- CELL SURFACE MEMBRANE DIAGRAM -->
  
  <!-- Phospholipid Bilayer Path definition / rendering -->
  <!-- Top layer of phospholipids -->
  <!-- We will draw them manually or grouped for a clean textbook look -->
  
  <g stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" fill="#ffffff">
    <!-- Top heads and tails -->
    <!-- Let's draw ~10 phospholipids in top layer, ~10 in bottom layer -->
    
    <!-- TOP LAYER -->
    <!-- 1 --> <circle cx="120" cy="120" r="10" fill="#ffffff"/><path d="M115,130 Q110,160 120,180 Q125,200 115,215" fill="none"/> <path d="M125,130 Q130,160 120,180 Q125,200 125,215" fill="none"/>
    <!-- 2 --> <circle cx="145" cy="120" r="10" fill="#ffffff"/><path d="M140,130 Q135,160 145,180 Q150,200 140,215" fill="none"/> <path d="M150,130 Q155,160 145,180 Q150,200 150,215" fill="none"/>
    <!-- 3 --> <circle cx="170" cy="120" r="10" fill="#ffffff"/><path d="M165,130 Q160,160 170,180 Q175,200 165,215" fill="none"/> <path d="M175,130 Q180,160 170,180 Q175,200 175,215" fill="none"/>
    
    <!-- Gap for Protein C (Channel protein) spanning ~ 230 to 290 -->

    <!-- 4 --> <circle cx="310" cy="120" r="10" fill="#ffffff"/><path d="M305,130 Q300,160 310,180 Q315,200 305,215" fill="none"/> <path d="M315,130 Q320,160 310,180 Q315,200 315,215" fill="none"/>
    <!-- 5 --> <circle cx="335" cy="120" r="10" fill="#ffffff"/><path d="M330,130 Q325,160 335,180 Q340,200 330,215" fill="none"/> <path d="M340,130 Q345,160 335,180 Q340,200 340,215" fill="none"/>
    <!-- 6 --> <circle cx="360" cy="120" r="10" fill="#ffffff"/><path d="M355,130 Q350,160 360,180 Q365,200 355,215" fill="none"/> <path d="M365,130 Q370,160 360,180 Q365,200 365,215" fill="none"/>

    <!-- Gap for Protein B (Globular protein) spanning ~ 420 to 500 -->

    <!-- 7 --> <circle cx="535" cy="120" r="10" fill="#ffffff"/><path d="M530,130 Q525,160 535,180 Q540,200 530,215" fill="none"/> <path d="M540,130 Q545,160 535,180 Q540,200 540,215" fill="none"/>
    <!-- 8 --> <circle cx="560" cy="120" r="10" fill="#ffffff"/><path d="M555,130 Q550,160 560,180 Q565,200 555,215" fill="none"/> <path d="M565,130 Q570,160 560,180 Q565,200 565,215" fill="none"/>

    <!-- BOTTOM LAYER -->
    <!-- 1 --> <circle cx="120" cy="300" r="10" fill="#ffffff"/><path d="M115,290 Q110,260 120,240 Q125,220 115,205" fill="none"/> <path d="M125,290 Q130,260 120,240 Q125,220 125,205" fill="none"/>
    <!-- 2 --> <circle cx="145" cy="300" r="10" fill="#ffffff"/><path d="M140,290 Q135,260 145,240 Q150,220 140,205" fill="none"/> <path d="M150,290 Q155,260 145,240 Q150,220 150,205" fill="none"/>
    <!-- 3 --> <circle cx="170" cy="300" r="10" fill="#ffffff"/><path d="M165,290 Q160,260 170,240 Q175,220 165,205" fill="none"/> <path d="M175,290 Q180,260 170,240 Q175,220 175,205" fill="none"/>
    <!-- 4 --> <circle cx="195" cy="300" r="10" fill="#ffffff"/><path d="M190,290 Q185,260 195,240 Q200,220 190,205" fill="none"/> <path d="M200,290 Q205,260 195,240 Q200,220 200,205" fill="none"/>

    <!-- Under channel protein C -->
    <!-- 5 --> <circle cx="310" cy="300" r="10" fill="#ffffff"/><path d="M305,290 Q300,260 310,240 Q315,220 305,205" fill="none"/> <path d="M315,290 Q320,260 310,240 Q315,220 315,205" fill="none"/>
    <!-- 6 --> <circle cx="335" cy="300" r="10" fill="#ffffff"/><path d="M330,290 Q325,260 335,240 Q340,220 330,205" fill="none"/> <path d="M340,290 Q345,260 335,240 Q340,220 340,205" fill="none"/>
    <!-- 7 --> <circle cx="360" cy="300" r="10" fill="#ffffff"/><path d="M355,290 Q350,260 360,240 Q365,220 355,205" fill="none"/> <path d="M365,290 Q370,260 360,240 Q365,220 365,205" fill="none"/>

    <!-- Under globular protein B -->
    <!-- 8 --> <circle cx="535" cy="300" r="10" fill="#ffffff"/><path d="M530,290 Q525,260 535,240 Q540,220 530,205" fill="none"/> <path d="M540,290 Q545,260 535,240 Q540,220 540,205" fill="none"/>
    <!-- 9 --> <circle cx="560" cy="300" r="10" fill="#ffffff"/><path d="M555,290 Q550,260 560,240 Q565,220 555,205" fill="none"/> <path d="M565,290 Q570,260 560,240 Q565,220 565,205" fill="none"/>
    
    <!-- Cholesterol molecule inside the bilayer (D) -->
    <g transform="translate(460, 205)">
      <polygon points="0,15 15,0 30,15 25,35 5,35" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="15" y1="0" x2="15" y2="-10" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- PROTEIN C (Channel Protein with pore) -->
  <g fill="#ffffff" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5">
    <!-- Left side of channel -->
    <path d="M 220,110 C 210,110 205,130 205,160 C 205,190 210,210 220,210 C 225,210 225,250 220,310 C 210,310 200,300 200,270 C 200,250 210,230 210,210 L 210,110 Z" />
    <!-- Right side of channel -->
    <path d="M 280,110 C 290,110 295,130 295,160 C 295,190 290,210 280,210 C 275,210 275,250 280,310 C 290,310 300,300 300,270 C 300,250 290,230 290,210 L 290,110 Z" />
    <!-- Inner pore opening -->
    <rect x="235" y="110" width="30" height="200" fill="#ffffff" stroke="none"/>
    <!-- Top and bottom contours for channel -->
    <path d="M 210,110 Q 250,120 290,110" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <path d="M 210,310 Q 250,300 290,310" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- PROTEIN B (Globular Protein) -->
  <g fill="#ffffff" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5">
    <path d="M 405,130 
             C 395,150 395,200 410,230 
             C 395,260 400,290 420,300 
             C 450,310 490,300 495,270 
             C 505,240 485,210 495,170 
             C 500,130 460,110 425,110 
             Z" />
  </g>

  <!-- STRUCTURE E (Glycoprotein with branched carbohydrate chain) -->
  <g fill="#ffffff" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5">
    <!-- Attached to Protein B or a lipid, let's attach to Protein B top right -->
    <circle cx="475" cy="115" r="5"/>
    <circle cx="490" cy="105" r="5"/>
    <circle cx="505" cy="110" r="5"/>
    <circle cx="495" cy="90" r="5"/>
    <!-- connecting lines -->
    <line x1="475" y1="110" x2="487" y2="108"/>
    <line x1="492" y1="100" x2="495" y2="95"/>
    <line x1="495" y1="105" x2="502" y2="108"/>
  </g>

  <!-- LABELS & POINTER LINES -->
  <g font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#000000">
    <!-- A: Phospholipid -->
    <line x1="145" y1="120" x2="70" y2="60" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="65" y="55" text-anchor="end">A</text>

    <!-- B: Globular protein / Integral protein -->
    <line x1="440" y1="160" x2="580" y2="60" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="585" y="55" text-anchor="start">B</text>

    <!-- C: Channel protein / Pore -->
    <line x1="250" y1="190" x2="150" y2="190" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="142" y="195" text-anchor="end">C</text>

    <!-- D: Cholesterol -->
    <line x1="475" y1="215" x2="570" y2="250" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="575" y="255" text-anchor="start">D</text>

    <!-- E: Glycoprotein -->
    <line x1="490" y1="100" x2="580" y2="130" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="585" y="135" text-anchor="start">E</text>
  </g>

</svg>
